title: Not-for-profit revenue & activities — Harbor Literacy Alliance
instructions: Harbor Literacy Alliance (a private NFP) is preparing its Year 2 statement of activities. Classify each transaction, then compute the change in each net asset class.

exhibits.title: Year 2 transactions
exhibits.content:
1. Unrestricted cash gifts: **$620,000**.
2. A foundation pledged **$150,000**, payable in Year 3, restricted to the adult-reading program. The pledge is unconditional; ignore discounting.
3. A corporation promised **$100,000** if Harbor raises **$100,000** of new donations by March 31, Year 3; otherwise the promise lapses. Harbor has raised **$40,000** of qualifying gifts.
4. Harbor spent **$90,000** on the adult-reading program, fully satisfying restrictions from gifts received in Year 1.
5. A CPA firm audited Harbor's books free of charge; Harbor would otherwise have paid **$18,000**.
6. Volunteers without special skills tutored children; fair value **$45,000**.
7. Members pay **$100** dues and receive a magazine worth **$20**; 1,000 members paid in Year 2.
8. Expenses (including the audit and adult-reading program): program **$560,000**, management & general **$120,000**, fundraising **$60,000**.

parts.prompt: How should Harbor report each item in Year 2?

rows.label: Item 2: foundation pledge
rows.explanation: Unconditional promise → recognize when received; purpose and time restricted.

rows.label: Item 3: corporate matching promise
rows.explanation: Matching barrier + right of release → conditional; the barrier is not yet met, and no cash was received.

rows.label: Item 5: donated audit services
rows.explanation: Specialized skills that would otherwise be purchased → recognize $18,000 revenue and expense.

rows.label: Item 6: volunteer tutoring
rows.explanation: No specialized skills and no nonfinancial asset created → not recognized (may be disclosed).

rows.label: Item 7: the $20 magazine portion of dues
rows.explanation: Members receive commensurate value for $20; the remaining $80 is a contribution.

rows.label: Net assets released from restrictions
rows.explanation: The adult-reading spending satisfied **90,000** of prior restrictions.
